fixes.fix: register() rolls back name2plugin entry and already-added hookimpls when hookimpl validation/registration fails
fixes.why: A PluginValidationError on a later hookimpl left the plugin half-registered (earlier impls active, name taken), so a fixed plugin could not be re-registered.
fixes.upstream_commit: 629246a Validate all hookimpls before registering a plugin

fixes.fix: parse_hookimpl_opts treats attributes whose getattr raises (e.g. raising property) as non-hooks
fixes.why: Registering a plugin with a property that raises crashed register() even though the property is not a hook.
fixes.upstream_commit: c1c39fe Discover hooks via inspect.getattr_static instead of getattr

fixes.fix: unregister() deletes the name2plugin entry for falsy plugin objects (is not None instead of truthiness)
fixes.why: A plugin with __len__ returning 0 lost its hookimpls but stayed registered by name, blocking re-registration.

fixes.fix: load_setuptools_entrypoints skips already-registered entry point plugins even when the plugin object is falsy
fixes.why: A falsy registered plugin was treated as not registered, so a second load attempted to register it again (ValueError / double load).
fixes.upstream_commit: e108fa4 fix: skip registered entrypoint plugins without checking truthiness (also 44474dd)

fixes.fix: subset_hook_caller also excludes plugins that implement the hook under a different attribute name via specname
fixes.why: hasattr(plug, name) missed specname impls, so the plugin requested for removal was still called.

fixes.fix: subset_hook_caller falls back to a list when plugins to remove are unhashable
fixes.why: Unhashable plugin objects are an unusual edge case; supporting them is a defensible extension, and upstream kept set(remove_plugins), which still raises TypeError.

fixes.fix: add_hookcall_monitoring undo only unhooks itself when outermost and otherwise deactivates, so out-of-order undo keeps later monitors
fixes.why: Calling the first monitor's undo restored the pre-monitor hookexec, silently removing every monitor added afterwards (e.g. tracing).

fixes.fix: _multicall records the 'has second yield' RuntimeError and continues tearing down outer wrappers before raising
fixes.why: A misbehaving inner new-style wrapper caused outer wrappers' teardown (finally blocks) to be skipped until garbage collection.

fixes.fix: call_historic copies the kwargs mapping before storing it in call history
fixes.why: Mutating the dict after the call changing what late plugins see is surprising, but it is caller misuse and a shallow copy is a policy choice.

fixes.fix: enable_tracing keeps trace indent balanced when writing the trace raises (e.g. a value whose repr raises)
fixes.why: An exception from tracing a value left indent permanently incremented, corrupting all later trace output.
fixes.upstream_commit: 1b23f2e Make hook tracing defensive about repr and surrogates (PR #728)

fixes.fix: _formatdef tolerates inspect.signature failures and missing __name__ when formatting validation error messages
fixes.why: On Python 3.14+ an unresolvable annotation makes inspect.signature raise NameError, replacing the intended PluginValidationError (niche, error-path only).
